text: According to the text, what is the specific difference between the 'Split' tab and the 'Source' tab in KompoZer?
choices: Split shows the preview and code side-by-side; Source shows only code.
Split displays the HTML source of the current element; Source shows all details of the HTML code.
Split allows editing CSS; Source allows editing HTML.
There is no difference; they are synonymous.
explanation: The text explicitly states: 'The Split tab displays the HTML source of the current element. Source tab shows all details of the HTML code.'.

text: In the KompoZer interface, where is the 'Edit Mode Toolbar' located?
choices: Top of the window, below the menu bar.
Left side, inside the Site Manager.
Bottom right side of the window.
Bottom left, next to the DOM Explorer.
explanation: The text describes the interface: 'The bottom right side of the window shows Edit mode toolbar with three viewing modes'.

text: When using the POST method, how is the data transmitted to the server?
choices: It is appended to the URL as query parameters.
It is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction.
It is sent as a separate email.
It is encrypted into a 'hidden' input field automatically.
explanation: In the POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction. The data is included in the body of the request.

text: Which visual cue indicates the presence of a Form when viewing a page in KompoZer's 'Normal' view?
choices: A dotted blue box surrounding elements.
explanation: You can see the form inserted with light blue colored outline in the untitled page as shown in figure 1.6.

text: What specific limitation does the 'Preview' mode have regarding scripts?
choices: It executes scripts slower than a browser.
It runs scripts but blocks pop-ups.
It only runs JavaScript, not CSS.
explanation: The Preview mode offers the page view as seen in a browser... The links also do not operate in preview mode. The scripts do not run.

text: In the HTML Tags view, what does a 'yellow marker' represent?
choices: The start tag for all elements.
explanation: The HTML Tags view helps those who are familiar with HTML. A yellow marker is used to indicate the start tag for all elements.

text: Which shortcut key is used to close the Site Manager pane in KompoZer?
explanation: You can close the site manager pane by clicking on close button or press F9.

text: To ensure multiple radio buttons belong to the same group (allowing only one selection), what attribute must be identical for all of them?
explanation: Though the text doesn't explicitly define the grouping logic in the summary table, the Example column shows: `<INPUT TYPE='radio' NAME='var' ...>`. In HTML, sharing the same `NAME` groups them. The text implies this by saying 'select a single item from a given group'.

text: What is the precise menu path to insert a label for a form field?
explanation: From the menu bar, select Insert -> Form -> Define Label.

text: If the `method` attribute is left empty in the Form Properties, what is the default behavior?
choices: It prompts the user to choose.
explanation: The default value for method attribute is GET.

text: What does the `cols` attribute in a `<textarea>` specifically control?
choices: The maximum number of characters allowed.
The number of columns of text visible without scrolling.
The total width of the form.
explanation: The cols attribute is used to set the number of columns of text that will be visible without scrolling right or left.

text: Which of the following form elements is a container tag (i.e., has a closing tag)?
explanation: The tag `<textarea>...</textarea>` is used to implement this element. Input is typically shown as `<input ...>` (void element).

text: In the Form Properties dialog box, which field corresponds to the 'Action' attribute?
explanation: Figure 1.4 shows the dialog box with the field labeled 'Action URL'.

text: What is the effect of the GET method on the URL upon submission?
choices: The data is appended to the end of the URL.
The URL redirects to the homepage.
explanation: The GET method retrieves the data from the form and sends it to the server by attaching it at the end of the URL.

text: Which toolbar allows for formatting operations like adding bullets and numbering?
explanation: The Format toolbar1 and Format toolbar2 are used to format the text, add bullets, numbering....

text: How many viewing modes does KompoZer provide in the Edit Mode Toolbar?
explanation: The bottom right side of the window shows Edit mode toolbar with three viewing modes: Normal, HTML Tags and Preview.

text: Which attribute of the `form` element takes a filename as its value?
explanation: The action attribute... It takes a filename as value.

text: What happens to the form data when the 'Reset' button is clicked?
choices: It is sent to the server.
It is deleted from the database.
Values are cleared and set back to default values.
explanation: On clicking the reset button, the values of data entered in the form are cleared and set back to default values.

text: Why does the POST method not have restrictions on data length compared to GET?
choices: Because it uses a larger URL buffer.
Because data is sent as a block in the HTTP transaction, not in the URL.
Because it splits data into multiple GET requests.
explanation: This method (GET) allows only a limited amount of information... In the POST method, the data is sent as a block... This method does not have any restrictions on data length.

text: In the Site Manager pane, what key can you press to close it?
explanation: You can close the site manager pane by clicking on close button or press F9.

text: Which element allows creating a menu where items are defined by `<option>` tags?
explanation: The select element is used to create a drop down list or menu... The tag <select>...</select> is used... The tag <option> is used to create elements.

text: What is the function of the 'Composition Toolbar'?
choices: It is used to create new files, open, save, or publish web pages.
explanation: The composition toolbar is used to create new file, open a file, save a file or publish a web page.

text: Which tab would you select to see the HTML source code of the specific element currently selected?
explanation: The Split tab displays the HTML source of the *current element*.

text: In the Password input field, characters are converted into:
explanation: The characters are not displayed to the user. Instead the character typed is converted into non readable format.

text: Which tag corresponds to the 'Submit' button described in the text?
explanation: Example column shows: `<INPUT TYPE = "submit" VALUE = "label" >`.

text: To open an existing file in KompoZer via the menu bar, which path is correct?
explanation: Alternatively, you can also click on File -> Open.

text: The 'Action' attribute specifies the filename. When is this file opened?
choices: When the user clicks the submit button.
When the user clicks the reset button.
explanation: This file is opened when the user clicks on the submit button after filling the data in the form.

text: What is the primary role of the 'Site Manager'?
choices: To navigate within the site or between sites.
explanation: Site manager is a powerful tool used to navigate within the site or between the sites.

text: Which toolbar allows you to create a form by clicking a 'Form' button?
explanation: Alternatively, you can also click on 'Form' in the composition toolbar.

text: Which file extension is associated with Cascading Style Sheets in KompoZer?
explanation: It also supports the use of 'Styles' through Cascading Style Sheet (CSS).
